tasks.title: الرجوع الكامل: فاتورة مرتجعة بالكامل/ملغاة تبقى بزر «مرتجع / إلغاء» فعّال وبلا حالة ظاهرة
tasks.brief: After a full return or cancellation the Invoices row keeps an enabled 'مرتجع / إلغاء' button, and the dialog for a fully returned sale still enables 'إرجاع كل الأصناف' and 'تأكيد المرتجع' while every qty input is disabled (screens d/m-dlg-fully-returned). Add a status badge in the المرتجع column (مرتجع جزئي / مرتجع بالكامل / ملغاة, with tone colours), disable or replace the row button with a disabled 'تم الإرجاع بالكامل' state (aria-disabled + tooltip), and in the dialog disable Return-all/Confirm and show an inline notice when nothing is returnable. Frontend-only (index.html return dialog around the data-return handler, ~line 5444). Preserve Black Edition Arabic RTL UX. Backend frozen. No deploy. Tests required (add a Playwright/node test under tests/ extending the ui-returns.mjs / ui-pos04-returns-cancel.mjs pattern and run it plus tests/ui-returns.mjs, tests/ui-pos04-returns-cancel.mjs, tests/ui-sales-ledger.mjs; record exact results). Evidence: .nova/qa/qa-loop-219.md.
tasks.acceptance: Fully returned/cancelled rows show a badge and no actionable return button; dialog confirm is disabled when no qty is available; test covers partial, full and cancelled.

tasks.title: زر الإغلاق ✕ يغطي عنوان نافذة المرتجع (RTL) والعنوان مقصوص
tasks.brief: In the return dialog the 44px close button is absolutely positioned over the h3, clipping the first letters of 'مرتجع / إلغاء — فاتورة S-1001' (d-dlg-open.png). Give the header a flex row (title + close) with proper gap, remove the 28px hack margin, keep close at 44px, and make the header sticky inside the scrollable dialog. Frontend-only (index.html return dialog around the data-return handler, ~line 5444). Preserve Black Edition Arabic RTL UX. Backend frozen. No deploy. Tests required (add a Playwright/node test under tests/ extending the ui-returns.mjs / ui-pos04-returns-cancel.mjs pattern and run it plus tests/ui-returns.mjs, tests/ui-pos04-returns-cancel.mjs, tests/ui-sales-ledger.mjs; record exact results). Evidence: .nova/qa/qa-loop-219.md.
tasks.acceptance: Title fully visible at 1366 and 390 with no overlap of the close button; bounding-box test.

tasks.title: نافذة المرتجع: الخطأ يبقى بعد تصحيح السبب، وكميات خارج النطاق بلا رسالة
tasks.brief: (a) After 'اكتب سبب المرتجع' is shown, picking a reason chip or typing a reason does not clear the red message. (b) Typing qty above the available, a fraction (1.5) or negative silently blanks 'مبلغ الإرجاع' with no message until confirm. Clear #novaRetMsg on input/chip, mark the offending qty input aria-invalid with an inline Arabic message ('الحد الأقصى N'), clamp on blur, use inputmode=numeric and step=1. Frontend-only (index.html return dialog around the data-return handler, ~line 5444). Preserve Black Edition Arabic RTL UX. Backend frozen. No deploy. Tests required (add a Playwright/node test under tests/ extending the ui-returns.mjs / ui-pos04-returns-cancel.mjs pattern and run it plus tests/ui-returns.mjs, tests/ui-pos04-returns-cancel.mjs, tests/ui-sales-ledger.mjs; record exact results). Evidence: .nova/qa/qa-loop-219.md.
tasks.acceptance: Error clears on fix; over-max/fraction/negative show inline message and aria-invalid; tests assert each.

tasks.title: لوحة المفاتيح: الـTab يهرب من نافذة المرتجع، والتركيز لا يعود لزر الفاتورة بعد الإغلاق
tasks.brief: Dialog has role=dialog aria-modal but no focus trap: after 14 Tab presses focus is outside the overlay; after Esc/close focus lands on BODY instead of the originating 'مرتجع / إلغاء' button. Add a Tab/Shift+Tab trap, aria-labelledby on the h3, restore focus to the opener on close, and lock background scroll while open. Frontend-only (index.html return dialog around the data-return handler, ~line 5444). Preserve Black Edition Arabic RTL UX. Backend frozen. No deploy. Tests required (add a Playwright/node test under tests/ extending the ui-returns.mjs / ui-pos04-returns-cancel.mjs pattern and run it plus tests/ui-returns.mjs, tests/ui-pos04-returns-cancel.mjs, tests/ui-sales-ledger.mjs; record exact results). Evidence: .nova/qa/qa-loop-219.md.
tasks.acceptance: Tab cycles inside the dialog; Esc/close returns focus to the opener; test asserts both.

tasks.title: نافذة المرتجع: حقول إلغاء الفاتورة رمادية غير مصممة، وعلامات النماذج بلا ربط
tasks.brief: Inside the 'إلغاء الفاتورة بالكامل' details the inputs/select are default grey (rgb 59/107) unlike the dark reason input, with no labels; the reason label has no for=, qty inputs have no aria-label (labelForReason:false, qtyAria empty). Style them with the same tokens as #novaRetReason, add real <label for>, aria-label per qty input with the product name, and style the details summary as a proper disclosure with a rotating chevron and a danger tone for the confirm-cancel button. Frontend-only (index.html return dialog around the data-return handler, ~line 5444). Preserve Black Edition Arabic RTL UX. Backend frozen. No deploy. Tests required (add a Playwright/node test under tests/ extending the ui-returns.mjs / ui-pos04-returns-cancel.mjs pattern and run it plus tests/ui-returns.mjs, tests/ui-pos04-returns-cancel.mjs, tests/ui-sales-ledger.mjs; record exact results). tasks.acceptance: All dialog fields share one style; every input has an accessible name; test asserts labels.

tasks.title: نافذة المرتجع: تذييل الأزرار يختفي عند فتح الإلغاء على سطح المكتب، والشرائح تلتف يتيمة على الموبايل

Frontend-only (index.html return dialog around the data-return handler, ~line 5444). Preserve Black Edition Arabic RTL UX. Backend frozen. No deploy. Tests required (add a Playwright/node test under tests/ extending the ui-returns.mjs / ui-pos04-returns-cancel.mjs pattern and run it plus tests/ui-returns.mjs, tests/ui-pos04-returns-cancel.mjs, tests/ui-sales-ledger.mjs; record exact results).
